decision_router.qm8_exact_and_peak_tree_at_or_below_9000: Do not activate q2. Freeze q1 as the resource-qualified experimental parent after all remaining identity, inverse, cleanup, repeat, and verifier gates pass.
decision_router.qm8_exact_but_peak_tree_above_9000000_ki: Authorize only a newly materialized 16 MiB-threshold q2 candidate, provided the terminal classifier attributes failure to residency pressure rather than probability, inverse, cleanup, or infrastructure.
decision_router.qm8_probability_payload_or_inverse_failu: Do not activate q2. Locate and correct the first semantic divergence only.
decision_router.qm8_infrastructure_incomplete: Do not activate q2. Correct only the exact infrastructure defect and retain the q1 source unchanged.
decision_router.q2_first_matched_gate: Re-run the exact opening and distant 10M q1 populations with parent/q2 integer-probability, payload, inverse, mapping-manifest, cleanup, scratch, process-tree RSS, VmHWM, cgroup, and runtime evidence.
decision_router.q2_promotion_condition: All exact identity and cleanup predicates pass, the worst matched process-tree peak is at least 262144 KiB below q1, and the q2 peak is at or below 8750000 KiB.
decision_router.q2_kill_condition: Any probability, payload, inverse, allocation-count, cleanup, or deterministic-repeat mismatch retires the mutation. Resource improvement below 262144 KiB also retires this storage threshold; do not rescue it by changing cadence, table geometry, or cgroup policy.
